newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Partners sees $2.3 mln from deal.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Partners sees $2.3 mln from deal.

text.p: Heartland Partners Lp said Friday it expected to receive cash payments of about $2.3 million over the next three years under a contract to develop a property here.

Heartland said it entered a contract for the development of 10.3 acres of its downtown Chicago Goose Island Industrial Park. Under the agreement Heartland, Colliers, Bennet and Kahnweiler, a Chicago-based real estate company, and Wooten Construction have formed a joint venture to develop about 300,000 square feet of the park during the next two years.
In addition to the $2.25 million, Heartland expected participate in the profits of the joint venture. The joint venture transaction was expected to close in the third quarter of 1997.

The company said it expected the $.75 per unit balance of the previously announced proposed $2.00-per-unit distribution will be paid following the closing and receipt of the initial proceeds of the venture.
